title: Acyclic 10-crate SRP architecture with core trait bridge
what: Split anvil into 10 single-responsibility crates under crates/ where domain crates depend only on anvil-core contracts and traits.
why: Prevents circular dependencies between anvil-memory and anvil-graph while enabling parallel Cargo compilation and <=350 line SRP files.
learned: Cross-crate staleness checks go through SymbolFreshnessProvider in anvil-core instead of linking anvil-memory directly to anvil-graph.
author: reactive-end
